title: A Static for the Protocol
author: Ines Sterling
blurb: Noor Hartwell, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
